image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a single car wheel lying flat on a light blue surface. The wheel features a dark brown or bronze-colored rim with an intricate, lattice-like spoke design that appears somewhat organic or melted. A thick, dark rubber tire surrounds the rim. There is a rectangular white label with gibberish black text attached to the sidewall of the tire. The lighting creates strong highlights on the rim's inner edges.

artifact_observations.location: White rectangular label on the tire sidewall
artifact_observations.reasoning: The label contains nonsensical characters ('ЛЫБЛД' or similar Cyrillic-like gibberish) that do not form any real word or standard tire marking. This is a classic AI generation artifact where text is simulated but not rendered correctly.

The central hub fails to resolve into a functional mechanical part. The spokes merge into the center in a way that defies engineering logic, appearing as a melted or fused lattice rather than distinct structural elements.

The intricate lattice work of the spokes has a soft, slightly blurry quality that lacks the sharp edges of machined metal. It resembles a 3D-printed resin model or a digital sculpture rather than a cast alloy wheel.
The circle of the wheel is slightly oval or warped, suggesting minor perspective distortion issues common in AI generations when rendering perfect circles from an angle.
